description: This file defines a class for Base64 encoding and decoding, used within the SourceMap component of the SCSSPHP project.

classes.name: Base64
classes.description: Provides static methods for encoding integers to Base64 characters and decoding Base64 characters to integers.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes an integer value to its corresponding Base64 character.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 character to its corresponding integer value.
